description: Redevelopment (following demolition of existing industrial/warehouse buildings) to provide a mixed-use development of two buildings. Western block ? up to 6 storeys: 33 affordable housing units (1,2,3 and 4 bedroom units) and site management office. Eastern block ? up to eight storeys: 91 private residential units (1,2 and 3 bedroom units), 589sq.m of office space (Use Class B1) and childcare facility (Use Class D1) of 478sq.m. Vehicular access off Colonial Drive and provision of 12 disabled car parking spaces and four integral cycle stores. Ground floor plant and refuse storage/recycling areas. Provision of footpath on North boundary to link Bollo Lane to Chiswick Business Park, associated public realm, landscaping and toddler play space.
